items.label: Figure 2
items.caption: Figure 2. Comparison of the representative local attention mechanisms with our area attention. Area Attention adopts the most straightforward equal partitioning way to divide the feature map into l areas vertically or horizontally (default is 4). This avoids complex operations while ensuring a large receptive field, resulting in high efficiency.
